personal.name: A Masrur Ahmed
personal.title: PhD
personal.bio: A dedicated data scientist with experience in applied AI (deep and machine learning) techniques for air quality, bias correction, hydrology, water resources, and climate extremes. My professional experience in building robust Machine Learning solutions for business and my PhD research experience has helped me to gain in-depth knowledge of hydrology and water resources. I have an ever-evolving research profile with ten years of experience. I am keen to build a career in applied data science and artificial intelligence to understand data and make impactful data-driven decisions.

researchFocusAreas.title: Air Quality Monitoring & Forecasting
researchFocusAreas.description: Advanced forecasting models for air quality index prediction using satellite-derived hydro-climatological variables and deep learning techniques.
researchFocusAreas.overview: Developing state-of-the-art deep learning models for air quality prediction and monitoring, with focus on real-time forecasting systems and sensor calibration using satellite data and atmospheric variables.

researchFocusAreas.title: Deep Learning for Hydrological Predictions
researchFocusAreas.description: Hybrid deep learning architectures including LSTM, GRU, CNN-LSTM for environmental predictions with innovative decomposition methods.
researchFocusAreas.overview: Pioneering hybrid deep learning methods combining multiple architectures (LSTM, GRU, CNN) with feature decomposition techniques (EEMD, CEEMDAN) for accurate hydrological forecasting across various temporal scales.

researchFocusAreas.title: Water Resources & Demand Forecasting
researchFocusAreas.description: Cutting-edge research in water demand modeling, irrigation forecasting, and water quality prediction using AI techniques.
researchFocusAreas.overview: Developing advanced models for water demand disaggregation, crop coefficient determination, and water quality forecasting to support sustainable water management under climate change scenarios.

researchFocusAreas.title: Climate Science & Energy Forecasting
researchFocusAreas.description: Machine learning models for climate extremes, renewable energy forecasting, and bias correction in numerical weather predictions.
researchFocusAreas.overview: Applying advanced ML techniques for solar energy forecasting, cloud cover bias correction, energy consumption prediction, and ultraviolet index modeling with optimization algorithms.

researchFocusAreas.title: Remote Sensing & Satellite Applications
researchFocusAreas.description: Utilizing satellite-derived variables and remote sensing data for agricultural, environmental, and climate predictions.
researchFocusAreas.overview: Leveraging satellite data (MODIS, Sentinel) for crop yield prediction, soil moisture estimation, and vegetation monitoring using machine learning approaches.

researchFocusAreas.title: Ocean & Sea Level Monitoring
researchFocusAreas.description: Sea level trend analysis and prediction in Pacific regions using advanced time series models.
researchFocusAreas.overview: Analyzing and forecasting sea level changes using reanalysis datasets and hybrid deep learning models.

researchFocusAreas.title: Materials Science Applications
researchFocusAreas.description: AI-driven prediction models for material properties with explainable AI techniques.
researchFocusAreas.overview: Applying hybrid intelligence models and SHAP algorithms for material property prediction and parametric analysis.

researchFocusAreas.title: Educational Data Analytics
researchFocusAreas.description: Predictive models for academic performance using machine learning regression techniques.
researchFocusAreas.overview: Developing novel multivariate adaptive regression models for student performance prediction.

researchFocusAreas.title: Environmental Impact & Legacy Research
researchFocusAreas.description: Early research on environmental assessment, waste management, and pollution monitoring in Bangladesh.
researchFocusAreas.overview: Foundational work in environmental impact assessment, solid waste management, and pollution control for industrial and urban areas.
